title: KiDS-Legacy: Cosmological constraints from cosmic shear with the complete Kilo-Degree Survey
efc_relevance: The high-side arm of the current S8 picture: S8 = 0.815 (+0.016/-0.021), in agreement with Planck at 0.73 sigma (Sigma8 = 0.821 (+0.014/-0.016) with alpha = 0.58). Against EFC's robust point value S8 ~ 0.82 the central value is 0.005 low and the 1-sigma upper edge (0.831) reaches it - a 1-sigma tail overlap, not a bracket. Accepted for publication in A&A.
ledger_action: Standalone source row added to the Atlas external-evidence register (FRAG-KIDS-LEGACY-S8) with the paper's own numbers and 1-sigma interval, closing the watchlist backlog item that asked for a KiDS-Legacy row. The existing tests.json entry conv_efc_p1_p2_cross_probe_test_against_des_y6_vs_kids_legacy_s8_ already cites this dataset and was NOT re-promoted: its recorded result stays NO_SIGNAL / status unknown, which is an internal status and not empirical support.
